description_en: Obtains a one-time token for a channel service request. The token is used to authenticate channel-related API operations and is invalidated after use
description_zh: 获取渠道服务请求一次性凭证，该凭证可用于渠道相关接口的鉴权，使用后失效
name: GetRequestToken

parameters.description_en: The ID of the channel. The request token is valid only for this channel.
parameters.description_zh: 渠道ID。获取渠道服务请求凭证，凭证仅在此渠道下生效。
parameters.help_en: The ID of the channel. The request token is valid only for this channel
parameters.help_zh: 渠道ID。获取渠道服务请求凭证，凭证仅在此渠道下生效
parameters.name: channel_id
